<p>Éditeur photo avec retouche par IA su:
Photo editor with AI retouching on your own PC.

Pixane is designed for people who are new to photo editing, or have little experience with it: the tools go straight to the point, the AI takes care of the hard work and the help explains every setting step by step. For advanced professional work, software such as Photoshop remains the reference; Pixane aims to make photo editing accessible to everyone.
